The primary visual element is a thick, light-colored wooden handrail that curves smoothly along the incline of the stairs. Instead of traditional vertical balusters, the railing is supported by large, transparent glass panels held in place by metal clamps or a channel system. In the background, another section of the staircase with a perforated metal mesh railing is visible. The lighting is artificial, creating reflections on the glass and wood surfaces.
